# Photo Gallery

<!-- This gallery automatically displays all photographs stored in the gallery folder. Descriptions are pulled from `assets/gallery/photo_descriptions.xlsx`. -->

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

from pathlib import Path
from IPython.display import display, Image
from openpyxl import load_workbook

# Gallery folder
gallery_folder = Path("assets/gallery")

# Supported image formats
extensions = {".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".webp", ".bmp"}

# Load descriptions from Excel using OpenPyXL
excel_path = gallery_folder / "photo_descriptions.xlsx"

try:
    workbook = load_workbook(excel_path, read_only=True, data_only=True)
    sheet = workbook.active

    # Read column headers
    headers = [
        str(cell.value).strip().lower() if cell.value else ""
        for cell in sheet[1]
    ]

    filename_col = headers.index("filename")
    description_col = headers.index("description")

    # Make a lookup dictionary: filename -> description
    desc_lookup = {}

    for row in sheet.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):
        filename = row[filename_col]
        description = row[description_col]

        if filename:
            desc_lookup[str(filename).strip()] = (
                str(description).strip() if description is not None else ""
            )

    workbook.close()

except Exception as e:
    print(f"**Warning:** Could not load descriptions.xlsx — {e}\n")
    desc_lookup = {}

# Extract all images
images = sorted([
    p for p in gallery_folder.iterdir()
    if p.is_file() and p.suffix.lower() in extensions
])

#print(f"Total photographs: {len(images)}\n")

# Display photographs
for i, photo in enumerate(images, start=1):

    #print(f"## Photograph {i}: {photo.name}\n")

    display(Image(
        filename=str(photo),
        width=600
    ))
    print("---\n")

    # Get description from Excel (fallback if missing)
    description = desc_lookup.get(
        photo.name,
        "No description available."
    )

    print(f" {description}\n")
    print("---\n")
```
